name: memory_store
description: Persistent key-value store with vector embedding — survives across sessions and is searchable by meaning, not just by file path. Use for project-scoped persistent memory. Never import personal memory automatically. Data is isolated by project_path; runtime reports actual embedding and storage backend.

upsert.description: Update existing key instead of failing (default: true, matching CLI `memory store`; set false for strict-insert). #2775 parity.

provenance_type.description: ADR-323: who/what produced this value, so shared-namespace retrieval can filter by trust level instead of conflating a user's stated claim with an agent's own output. Default: "unknown".

project_path.description: Absolute path to the existing project directory. Always use the current task workspace. Each canonical path has its own isolated Ruflo store.

name: memory_retrieve
description: Read back a value previously stored via memory_store, by exact (namespace, key) — lossless, includes metadata. Use for project-scoped persistent memory. Never import personal memory automatically. Data is isolated by project_path; runtime reports actual embedding and storage backend.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the existing project directory. Always use the current task workspace. Each canonical path has its own isolated Ruflo store.

name: memory_search
description: Find stored memories by meaning (vector similarity), not by literal text — finds "JWT auth pattern" when you query "token-based login flow". Use for project-scoped persistent memory. Never import personal memory automatically. Data is isolated by project_path; runtime reports actual embedding and storage backend.

namespace.description: Namespace to search (default: all namespaces — omit to search across every namespace)

threshold.description: Minimum raw retrieval relevance 0-1 for candidate admission, applied per query before SmartRetrieval ranking; not a floor on rankingScore (default: 0.2; calibrated for the bundled embedding model, pass 0 to see every match)

smart.description: Enable SmartRetrieval — query expansion, RRF fusion, recency boost, MMR diversity; preserves raw similarity and adds rankingScore (default: false)

provenance_filter.description: ADR-323: restrict results to these provenance types (e.g. exclude user_claim when fact-checking). Omit for no filtering. Enforced for standard and SmartRetrieval searches.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the existing project directory. Always use the current task workspace. Each canonical path has its own isolated Ruflo store.

name: memory_delete
description: Remove a stored memory entry by exact (namespace, key). Use for project-scoped persistent memory. Never import personal memory automatically. Data is isolated by project_path; runtime reports actual embedding and storage backend.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the existing project directory. Always use the current task workspace. Each canonical path has its own isolated Ruflo store.

name: memory_list
description: Enumerate stored memory entries (optionally filtered by namespace/tags) without semantic search. Use for project-scoped persistent memory. Never import personal memory automatically. Data is isolated by project_path; runtime reports actual embedding and storage backend.

tags.description: Require entries to include all of these tags (AND). Matches the description claim "optionally filtered by namespace/tags".

project_path.description: Absolute path to the existing project directory. Always use the current task workspace. Each canonical path has its own isolated Ruflo store.
